"Diminui o FPS para não ficar muito travada e também eu quero que esse jogo você possa escolher a arma e agora que você derrota o saci saci vai te dar uma caixa e se você apertar um botão você vai girar a caixa mas você não vai estar vendo ela daí vai cair uma arma nela outra para você se cair essa arma quando você pegar ela você já pode usar ela com bala infinita o problema é que se você se você pode escolher entre ir na caixa não se você girar é garantido uma caixa em cada só assim mas se você gerar a caixa o saci vai começar a focar em você vamos ficar duas vezes mais rápido e com duas vezes mais de vida

6: function getBoiTexture() {
7:   if (boiTexture) return boiTexture
8:   boiTexture = canvasTexture(256, 128, (ctx, w, h) => {
9:     ctx.fillStyle = '#1c1030'
10:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
11:     const cols = ['#ff3d8b', '#ffcf3f', '#2ee6c8', '#ff7a2f', '#8a5cff']
12:     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
13:       ctx.fillStyle = cols[i % cols.length]
14:       ctx.beginPath()
15:       const x = i * 28
16:       ctx.moveTo(x, h / 2)
17:       ctx.lineTo(x + 14, h / 2 - 22)
18:       ctx.lineTo(x + 28, h / 2)
19:       ctx.lineTo(x + 14, h / 2 + 22)
20:       ctx.closePath()
21:       ctx.fill()
22:     }
23:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'
24:     for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) ctx.fillRect(rand(0, w), rand(0, h), 2, 2)
25:   })
26:   boiTexture.wrapS = boiTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
27:   boiTexture.repeat.set(2, 1)
28:   return boiTexture
29: }

31: class Enemy {
32:   constructor(game, type, pos) {
33:     this.game = game
34:     this.type = type
35:     this.dead = false
36:     this.flash = 0
37:     this.spawnT = 0
38:     this.age = 0
39:     this.attackTimer = rand(0.8, 2.2)
40:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
41:     this.group.position.copy(pos)
42:     this.baseY = 0
43:     this.knock = new THREE.Vector3()
44:     this.materials = []
45:   }
46: 
47:   addMat(m) { this.materials.push(m); return m }
48: 
49:   updateFlash(dt) {
50:     this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 4)
51:     const s = 1 + this.flash * 0.09
52:     this.group.scale.setScalar(this.spawnScale * s)
53:   }
54: 
55:   takeDamage(amount, point) {
56:     if (this.dead || this.dying) return false
57:     this.hp -= amount
58:     this.flash = 1
59:     this.game.effects.hit(point || this.center(), this.hitColor || 0xffd76a, 6)
60:     this.game.audio.hit()
61:     if (this.hp <= 0) {
62:       this.die()
63:       return true
64:     }
65:     return false
66:   }
67: 
68:   die() {
69:     this.dead = true
70:     this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), this.type === 'boi' ? 1.5 : 1)
71:     this.game.audio.kill()
72:     this.game.onEnemyKilled?.(this)
73:     this.game.world.scene.remove(this.group)
74:     this.dispose()
75:   }
76: 
77:   dispose() {
78:     this.group.traverse((o) => {
79:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose?.()
80:       if (o.material) {
81:         const ms = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]
82:         ms.forEach((m) => m.dispose?.())
83:       }
84:     })
85:   }
86: 
87:   center() {
88:     return new THREE.Vector3(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.y + (this.hitY || 1), this.group.position.z)
89:   }
90: }

141:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
142:       const a = (i / 7) * TAU
143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))
144:       feather.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.35, 0.55 + Math.sin(a * 2) * 0.08, -0.05)
145:       feather.rotation.z = Math.cos(a) * 0.9
146:       feather.rotation.x = Math.sin(a) * 0.9 - 0.2
147:       this.group.add(feather)

149:     // halo ring
150:     const halo = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.75, 0.025, 4, 32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff5aa8, transparent: true, opacity: 0.65 }))
151:     halo.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.2
152:     halo.position.z = -0.15
153:     this.group.add(halo)
154:     this.halo = halo
155: 
156:     const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
157:       map: glowTexture('rgba(255,120,190,0.85)', 'rgba(255,40,120,0)'),
158:       color: 0xff6ab4, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, opacity: 0.42,

171:     this.spawnScale = this.spawnT
172:     this.updateFlash(dt)
173:     const p = this.game.player.position
174:     const dx = p.x - this.group.position.x
175:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
176:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7
187:     const tl = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1
188:     this.group.position.x += (tx / tl) * speed * dt
189:     this.group.position.z += (tz / tl) * speed * dt
190:     const r = Math.hypot(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.z)
191:     if (r > 24) {
192:       this.group.position.x *= 24 / r
193:       this.group.position.z *= 24 / r
194:     }
195:     this.group.position.y = this.baseY + Math.sin(this.age * 1.6 + this.hitRadius) * 0.22
196:     this.group.lookAt(p.x, this.group.position.y, p.z)
197:     this.halo.rotation.z += dt * 1.4
198: 
199:     // attack
200:     this.attackTimer -= dt
201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }
214: 
215:   fire() {
216:     const origin = this.center()
217:     const target = this.game.player.eyePosition
218:     const dir = target.sub(origin).normalize()
219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })
220:     this.game.effects.flash(origin, 1.8, 0xff8ac4, 0.12)
221:   }
222: }

457:       this.group.position.x += (dx / dist) * sp * dt
458:       this.group.position.z += (dz / dist) * sp * dt
459:       this.group.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.age * 5)) * 0.05
460:       if (dist < 13 && this.stateT <= 0) {
461:         this.state = 'windup'
462:         this.stateT = 0.85
463:         this.game.audio.tone(180, 0.5, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.08, to: 90 })
464:       }
465:     } else if (this.state === 'windup') {
466:       this.group.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.age * 16)) * 0.06
467:       this.group.position.x -= (dx / dist) * 0.8 * dt
468:       this.group.position.z -= (dz / dist) * 0.8 * dt
469:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {
470:         this.state = 'charge'
471:         this.stateT = 0.95
472:         this.chargeDir.set(dx / dist, 0, dz / dist)
473:         this.game.effects.ring(this.group.position, { color: 0xff3d3d, from: 0.4, to: 3, life: 0.4, flat: true })
474:         this.game.audio.tone(90, 0.4, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.14, to: 220 })
475:       }
476:     } else if (this.state === 'charge') {
477:       const step = 16 * dt
478:       const before = this.group.position.clone()
479:       this.group.position.addScaledVector(this.chargeDir, step)
480:       this.group.position.y = 0
481:       this.game.world.collide(this.group.position, 1.0)
482:       const moved = before.distanceTo(this.group.position)
483:       if (dist < 2.4) {
484:         this.game.player.takeDamage(20, this.group.position)
485:         this.state = 'stun'
486:         this.stateT = 1.3
487:         this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), 0.8)
488:       } else if (moved < step * 0.55 || this.stateT <= 0) {
489:         this.state = 'stun'
490:         this.stateT = 1.4
491:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(this.center(), 16, { color: 0xffcf3f, color2: 0xff7a2e, speed: 6, spread: 0.7, life: 0.5, size: 0.5 })
492:         this.game.audio.tone(70, 0.3, { type: 'sine', gain: 0.2, to: 40 })
493:       }
494:     } else if (this.state === 'stun') {
495:       this.group.position.y = 0
496:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {
497:         this.state = 'idle'
498:         this.stateT = rand(1.2, 2.2)
499:       }
500:     }
501:     this.group.lookAt(p.x, this.group.position.y + 1, p.z)
502:   }
503: }

740: /* ====================================================== MANAGER */
741: export class EnemyManager {
742:   constructor(game) {
743:     this.game = game
744:     this.list = []
745:     this.projectiles = []
746:     this.shockwaves = []
747:     this.boss = null
748:   }
749: 
750:   reset() {
751:     for (const e of this.list) {
752:       this.game.world.scene.remove(e.group)
753:       e.dispose?.()
754:     }
755:     this.list.length = 0
756:     for (const p of this.projectiles) this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
757:     this.projectiles.length = 0
758:     for (const s of this.shockwaves) this.game.world.scene.remove(s.mesh)
759:     this.shockwaves.length = 0
760:     this.boss = null
761:   }
762: 
763:   spawn(type, pos) {
764:     let e
765:     if (type === 'mask') e = new Mask(this.game, pos)
766:     else if (type === 'saci') e = new Saci(this.game, pos)
767:     else if (type === 'boi') e = new Boi(this.game, pos)
768:     else if (type === 'boss') {
769:       e = new Boss(this.game, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -34))
770:       this.boss = e
771:     }
772:     if (e) this.list.push(e)
773:     return e
774:   }
775: 
776:   countOfType(type) {
777:     return this.list.filter((e) => !e.dead && e.type === type).length
778:   }
779: 
780:   aliveCount() {
781:     return this.list.filter((e) => !e.dead).length
782:   }
783: 
784:   spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed = 10, damage = 10, color = 0xff5aa8, owner = null } = {}) {
785:     const mesh = new THREE.Group()
786:     const orb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 8, 7), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color }))
787:     mesh.add(orb)
788:     const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
789:       map: glowTexture('rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', 'rgba(255,80,160,0)'),
790:       color, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
791:     }))
792:     glow.scale.set(1.4, 1.4, 1)
793:     mesh.add(glow)
794:     mesh.position.copy(origin)
795:     this.game.world.scene.add(mesh)
796:     this.projectiles.push({
797:       mesh, dir: dir.clone().normalize(), speed, damage, color, owner,
798:       life: 4.5, trail: 0,
799:     })
800:   }
801: 
802:   spawnShockwave(pos, { damage = 12, speed = 9, maxRadius = 34, color = 0xff3d8b } = {}) {
803:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
804:       color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
805:       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false,
806:     })
807:     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.92, 1, 64), mat)
808:     mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
809:     mesh.position.set(pos.x, 0.85, pos.z)
810:     mesh.scale.setScalar(1)
811:     this.game.world.scene.add(mesh)
812:     this.shockwaves.push({ mesh, radius: 1, speed, maxRadius, damage, hit: false, color })
813:   }
814: 
815:   raycast(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
816:     let best = null
817:     const center = new THREE.Vector3()
818:     for (const e of this.list) {
819:       if (e.dead) continue
820:       center.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z)
821:       const oc = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(center, origin)
822:       const tca = oc.dot(dir)
823:       if (tca < 0) continue
824:       const d2 = oc.lengthSq() - tca * tca
825:       const r2 = e.hitRadius * e.hitRadius
826:       if (d2 > r2) continue
827:       const thc = Math.sqrt(r2 - d2)
828:       const t = tca - thc
829:       if (t < 0 || t > maxDist) continue
830:       if (!best || t < best.dist) {
831:         best = {
832:           enemy: e,
833:           dist: t,
834:           point: origin.clone().addScaledVector(dir, t),
835:           center: center.clone(),
836:         }
837:       }
838:     }
839:     return best
840:   }
841: 
842:   findAimTarget(origin, dir, maxAngle = 0.1, maxDist = 70) {
843:     let best = null
844:     const to = new THREE.Vector3()
845:     for (const e of this.list) {
846:       if (e.dead) continue
847:       to.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z).sub(origin)
848:       const dist = to.length()
849:       if (dist > maxDist || dist < 0.1) continue
850:       to.divideScalar(dist)
851:       const ang = Math.acos(clamp(to.dot(dir), -1, 1))
852:       const allowance = Math.max(maxAngle, Math.atan2(e.hitRadius, dist) * 0.85)
853:       if (ang < allowance) {
854:         const weight = ang - (1 - dist / maxDist) * 0.004
855:         if (!best || weight < best.weight) best = { enemy: e, weight, angle: ang }
856:       }
857:     }
858:     return best
859:   }
860: 
861:   damageInRadius(pos, radius, damage, source = null) {
862:     let hits = 0
863:     for (const e of this.list) {
864:       if (e.dead) continue
865:       const c = e.center()
866:       const d = c.distanceTo(pos)
867:       if (d < radius + e.hitRadius) {
868:         const falloff = clamp(1 - d / (radius + e.hitRadius) * 0.55, 0.45, 1)
869:         e.takeDamage(damage * falloff, c)
870:         hits++
871:       }
872:     }
873:     return hits
874:   }
875: 
876:   update(dt) {
877:     for (const e of this.list) {
878:       if (!e.dead) e.update(dt)
879:     }
880:     // remove dead non-boss entries
881:     for (let i = this.list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
882:       const e = this.list[i]
883:       if (e.dead) {
884:         if (e.type === 'boss') this.boss = null
885:         this.list.splice(i, 1)
886:       }
887:     }
888: 
889:     // projectiles
890:     for (let i = this.projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
891:       const p = this.projectiles[i]
892:       p.life -= dt
893:       p.mesh.position.addScaledVector(p.dir, p.speed * dt)
894:       p.mesh.rotation.y += dt * 4
895:       p.trail -= dt
896:       if (p.trail <= 0) {
897:         p.trail = 0.04
898:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(p.mesh.position, 1, {
899:           color: p.color, color2: 0xffffff, speed: 0.6, spread: 0.05, life: 0.25,
900:           size: 0.35, gravity: 0, drag: 0.9,
901:         })
902:       }
903:       const pp = this.game.player.position
904:       const d = Math.hypot(p.mesh.position.x - pp.x, p.mesh.position.z - pp.z)
905:       const yHit = p.mesh.position.y > 0.4 && p.mesh.position.y < 2.3
906:       let remove = false
907:       if (d < 0.75 && yHit) {
908:         this.game.player.takeDamage(p.damage, p.mesh.position)
909:         this.game.effects.hit(p.mesh.position, p.color, 10)
910:         remove = true
911:       }
912:       if (p.life <= 0 || p.mesh.position.y < 0.1 || Math.hypot(p.mesh.position.x, p.mesh.position.z) > 32) remove = true
913:       if (remove) {
914:         this.game.effects.hit(p.mesh.position, p.color, 6)
915:         this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
916:         this.projectiles.splice(i, 1)
917:       }
918:     }
919: 
920:     // boss shockwaves
921:     const pp = this.game.player.position
922:     for (let i = this.shockwaves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
923:       const s = this.shockwaves[i]
924:       s.radius += s.speed * dt
925:       const k = s.radius / s.maxRadius
926:       s.mesh.scale.setScalar(s.radius)
927:       s.mesh.material.opacity = 0.85 * (1 - k) + 0.1
928:       if (!s.hit) {
929:         const d = Math.hypot(pp.x - s.mesh.position.x, pp.z - s.mesh.position.z)
930:         if (Math.abs(d - s.radius) < 1.0) {
931:           const dealt = this.game.player.takeDamage(s.damage, s.mesh.position)

## Objective
- Modify the existing SACI STRIKE game to reduce choppiness and add weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- After defeating Saci, it gives the player a crate.
- The player can press a button to spin the crate without seeing its contents; it then awards a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and can be used after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game files, including its main game loop, weapons, enemies, UI, player, HTML, and styles.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect relevant game loop, enemy defeat/reward, weapon switching, input, and UI code.
2. Implement reduced choppiness, weapon choice, and the crate/spin/Saci behavior.
3. Run the game and verify the changes.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game bootstrap, waves, and game loop.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapons, firing, and weapon switching.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard and other input handling.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD and game screens.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI styling.

## Important Context
- No files were changed; the request remains unimplemented.
- The user’s request was in Portuguese.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e4eb252aaffeKETyVVhUXiaBUv" state="completed">
## Findings

### Performance hotspots

- **Two render passes per frame:** `Game.loop()` caps `dt` at 50 ms, runs `tick()`, then renders the world and—while playing or paused—the weapon scene separately. This is expected for the viewmodel, but means both scenes incur per-frame render work.  
  [src/main.js:636](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L636) · [src/main.js:641](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L641)

- **The playing tick updates all major systems and UI every frame:** input, player, weapons, enemies, pickups, world, effects, waves, HUD, boss UI, and automatic quality monitoring are all reached from the playing-state path.  
  [src/main.js:589](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L589)

- **Enemy work scales with the live enemy count:** `EnemyManager.update()` updates each living enemy, then scans the list backward to remove dead entries. Hitscan firing also scans enemies in `raycast()`. Additionally, the HUD calls `findAimTarget()` every frame, which performs another linear enemy scan. Both targeting methods allocate temporary `Vector3` objects; the raycast creates one per candidate enemy. These are likely scaling/GC hotspots as enemy counts rise, though profiling would be needed to confirm their actual impact.  
  [src/enemies.js:815](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L815) · [src/enemies.js:842](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L842) · [src/enemies.js:876](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L876) · [src/ui.js:126](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js#L126)

- **Hit effects and projectiles add recurring work:** Berimbau shots do a world ray-distance check and enemy raycast, then spawn tracer/muzzle/hit effects. Enemy projectiles emit trail particles on a timer while updating.  
  [src/weapons.js:248](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L248) · [src/enemies.js:889](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L889)

- **A performance fallback already exists:** after startup, the game samples FPS over 3.5-second windows; if FPS falls below 38 while quality is high, it switches to reduced quality once.  
  [src/main.js:619](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L619)

### Weapon switching and input

- **Q, Tab, 1, and 2 all queue the same toggle action.** The `1` and `2` keys do not directly select a particular weapon. Touch users have a switch button that queues the same action.  
  [src/input.js:40](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js#L40) · [src/input.js:191](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js#L191)

- `WeaponSystem.update()` consumes the queued switch; switching toggles between the two weapon indices and is blocked while the switch animation timer exceeds 0.05 seconds. Firing is also gated during the switch animation.  
  [src/weapons.js:153](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L153) · [src/weapons.js:162](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L162) · [src/weapons.js:188](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L188)

### Saci death and rewards

- **Saci stats:** 20 HP and 130 base score.  
  [src/enemies.js:225](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L225)

- **Death uses the shared enemy path:** `die()` marks the enemy dead, triggers explosion/audio, calls `onEnemyKilled`, removes its group from the scene, and disposes its geometry/materials. The manager later removes the dead enemy from its list.  
  [src/enemies.js:68](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L68) · [src/enemies.js:880](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L880)

- **Rewards:** a kill increments the kill count and updates the combo multiplier (capped at 4×), then awards rounded `enemy score × multiplier`. Saci has an 18% pickup-drop chance; on a successful roll, the drop is selected among açaí, shield, rapid-fire, or coin. Boi drops are guaranteed instead.  
  [src/main.js:420](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L420)

- Pickup effects include healing, shield, an eight-second rapid-fire boost, or bonus points, depending on type.  
  [src/main.js:443](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L443)

### HUD/UI patterns and player death

- **Most HUD writes are cache-guarded:** health, shield, score, wave, weapon, ammo, and dash values update DOM only when their displayed value changes. However, the dash-button cooldown class and combo visibility are toggled during each HUD refresh, and aim targeting is recalculated every refresh.  
  [src/ui.js:76](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js#L76) · [src/ui.js:116](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js#L116) · [src/ui.js:126](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js#L126)

- **Boss HUD is refreshed separately each playing frame:** it updates the fill width and percentage text while a boss is alive.  
  [src/main.js:599](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L599) · [src/ui.js:133](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js#L133)

- **Player death flow:** damage is ignored if the player is already dead or invulnerable; shield absorbs damage first, then health is reduced. Reaching zero marks the player dead and calls `onDeath`, which the game wires to `gameOver()`.  
  [src/player.js:168](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js#L168) · [src/main.js:112](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L112)

These performance observations are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results; profiling under a high-enemy/effect load would establish which ones dominate in practice.
</subagent>

## Objective
- Improve the existing SACI STRIKE game’s smoothness and add weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player can spin the crate without seeing its contents, then receive a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture and relevant gameplay, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.
- Identified potential per-frame performance costs, including two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs before editing.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address measured or clear sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD and screen updates.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries; the playing tick also updates multiple gameplay systems and HUD elements each frame.
- No changes have been made; the requested features remain unimplemented.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the existing SACI STRIKE game’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player can spin the crate without seeing its contents, then receive a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture and relevant gameplay, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs before editing.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address measured or clear sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD and screen updates.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries; the playing tick also updates multiple gameplay systems and HUD elements each frame.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the SACI STRIKE game’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player can spin the crate without seeing its contents, then receive a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture and relevant gameplay, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs before editing.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address measured or clear sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD and screen updates.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries; the playing tick also updates multiple gameplay systems and HUD elements each frame.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

766:     else if (type === 'saci') e = new Saci(this.game, pos)

805:       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false,
806:     })
807:     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.92, 1, 64), mat)
808:     mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2

815:   raycast(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
816:     let best = null
817:     const center = new THREE.Vector3()
818:     for (const e of this.list) {
819:       if (e.dead) continue
820:       center.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z)
821:       const oc = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(center, origin)
822:       const tca = oc.dot(dir)
823:       if (tca < 0) continue
824:       const d2 = oc.lengthSq() - tca * tca
825:       const r2 = e.hitRadius * e.hitRadius
826:       if (d2 > r2) continue
827:       const thc = Math.sqrt(r2 - d2)
828:       const t = tca - thc
829:       if (t < 0 || t > maxDist) continue
830:       if (!best || t < best.dist) {
831:         best = {
832:           enemy: e,
833:           dist: t,
834:           point: origin.clone().addScaledVector(dir, t),
835:           center: center.clone(),
836:         }
837:       }
838:     }
839:     return best
840:   }

842:   findAimTarget(origin, dir, maxAngle = 0.1, maxDist = 70) {
843:     let best = null
844:     const to = new THREE.Vector3()
845:     for (const e of this.list) {
846:       if (e.dead) continue
847:       to.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z).sub(origin)
848:       const dist = to.length()
849:       if (dist > maxDist || dist < 0.1) continue

## Objective
- Improve the SACI STRIKE game’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player can spin the crate without seeing its contents, then receive a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture and relevant gameplay, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs before editing.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address measured or clear sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD and screen updates.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries; the playing tick also updates multiple gameplay systems and HUD elements each frame.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

141:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
142:       const a = (i / 7) * TAU
143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))

151:     halo.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.2

171:     this.spawnScale = this.spawnT
172:     this.updateFlash(dt)
173:     const p = this.game.player.position
174:     const dx = p.x - this.group.position.x
175:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
176:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7
187:     const tl = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1
188:     this.group.position.x += (tx / tl) * speed * dt
189:     this.group.position.z += (tz / tl) * speed * dt
190:     const r = Math.hypot(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.z)
191:     if (r > 24) {
192:       this.group.position.x *= 24 / r
193:       this.group.position.z *= 24 / r

195:     this.group.position.y = this.baseY + Math.sin(this.age * 1.6 + this.hitRadius) * 0.22

197:     this.halo.rotation.z += dt * 1.4

199:     // attack
200:     this.attackTimer -= dt
201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })

221:   }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the SACI STRIKE game’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player can spin the crate without seeing its contents, then receive a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game architecture and relevant gameplay, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs before editing.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address measured or clear sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD and screen updates.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries; the playing tick also updates multiple gameplay systems and HUD elements each frame.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the SACI STRIKE game’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player spins the crate without seeing its contents, then receives a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game’s main gameplay, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address clear or measured sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

444:   update(dt) {

447:     this.spawnScale = this.spawnT
448:     this.updateFlash(dt)
449:     const p = this.game.player.position
450:     const dx = p.x - this.group.position.x
451:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
452:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
453:     this.stateT -= dt
454: 
455:     if (this.state === 'idle') {
456:       const sp = 1.7
457:       this.group.position.x += (dx / dist) * sp * dt
458:       this.group.position.z += (dz / dist) * sp * dt
459:       this.group.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.age * 5)) * 0.05
460:       if (dist < 13 && this.stateT <= 0) {
461:         this.state = 'windup'
462:         this.stateT = 0.85
463:         this.game.audio.tone(180, 0.5, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.08, to: 90 })
464:       }
465:     } else if (this.state === 'windup') {
466:       this.group.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.age * 16)) * 0.06
467:       this.group.position.x -= (dx / dist) * 0.8 * dt
468:       this.group.position.z -= (dz / dist) * 0.8 * dt
469:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {

471:         this.stateT = 0.95
472:         this.chargeDir.set(dx / dist, 0, dz / dist)
473:         this.game.effects.ring(this.group.position, { color: 0xff3d3d, from: 0.4, to: 3, life: 0.4, flat: true })
474:         this.game.audio.tone(90, 0.4, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.14, to: 220 })
475:       }
476:     } else if (this.state === 'charge') {
477:       const step = 16 * dt
478:       const before = this.group.position.clone()
479:       this.group.position.addScaledVector(this.chargeDir, step)
480:       this.group.position.y = 0
481:       this.game.world.collide(this.group.position, 1.0)
482:       const moved = before.distanceTo(this.group.position)
483:       if (dist < 2.4) {

485:         this.state = 'stun'
486:         this.stateT = 1.3
487:         this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), 0.8)
488:       } else if (moved < step * 0.55 || this.stateT <= 0) {
489:         this.state = 'stun'

491:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(this.center(), 16, { color: 0xffcf3f, color2: 0xff7a2e, speed: 6, spread: 0.7, life: 0.5, size: 0.5 })

497:         this.state = 'idle'
498:         this.stateT = rand(1.2, 2.2)
499:       }

501:     this.group.lookAt(p.x, this.group.position.y + 1, p.z)

741: export class EnemyManager {

753:       e.dispose?.()
754:     }
755:     this.list.length = 0
756:     for (const p of this.projectiles) this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
757:     this.projectiles.length = 0

763:   spawn(type, pos) {
764:     let e
765:     if (type === 'mask') e = new Mask(this.game, pos)
766:     else if (type === 'saci') e = new Saci(this.game, pos)
767:     else if (type === 'boi') e = new Boi(this.game, pos)
768:     else if (type === 'boss') {

784:   spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed = 10, damage = 10, color = 0xff5aa8, owner = null } = {}) {
785:     const mesh = new THREE.Group()
786:     const orb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 8, 7), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color }))
787:     mesh.add(orb)

803:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
804:       color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
805:       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false,
806:     })
807:     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.92, 1, 64), mat)
808:     mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
809:     mesh.position.set(pos.x, 0.85, pos.z)

815:   raycast(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
816:     let best = null
817:     const center = new THREE.Vector3()
818:     for (const e of this.list) {
819:       if (e.dead) continue
820:       center.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z)
821:       const oc = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(center, origin)
822:       const tca = oc.dot(dir)
823:       if (tca < 0) continue
824:       const d2 = oc.lengthSq() - tca * tca
825:       const r2 = e.hitRadius * e.hitRadius
826:       if (d2 > r2) continue

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate.
- The player spins the crate without seeing its contents, then receives a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the main gameplay, enemy, weapon, input, UI, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the exact game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address clear or measured sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `EnemyManager.update()` updates living enemies and removes dead entries.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

31: class Enemy {
32:   constructor(game, type, pos) {
33:     this.game = game
34:     this.type = type
35:     this.dead = false
36:     this.flash = 0
37:     this.spawnT = 0
38:     this.age = 0
39:     this.attackTimer = rand(0.8, 2.2)
40:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
41:     this.group.position.copy(pos)
42:     this.baseY = 0
43:     this.knock = new THREE.Vector3()
44:     this.materials = []
45:   }
46: 
47:   addMat(m) { this.materials.push(m); return m }
48: 
49:   updateFlash(dt) {
50:     this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 4)
51:     const s = 1 + this.flash * 0.09
52:     this.group.scale.setScalar(this.spawnScale * s)
53:   }
54: 
55:   takeDamage(amount, point) {
56:     if (this.dead || this.dying) return false
57:     this.hp -= amount
58:     this.flash = 1
59:     this.game.effects.hit(point || this.center(), this.hitColor || 0xffd76a, 6)
60:     this.game.audio.hit()
61:     if (this.hp <= 0) {
62:       this.die()
63:       return true
64:     }
65:     return false
66:   }
67: 
68:   die() {
69:     this.dead = true
70:     this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), this.type === 'boi' ? 1.5 : 1)
71:     this.game.audio.kill()
72:     this.game.onEnemyKilled?.(this)
73:     this.game.world.scene.remove(this.group)
74:     this.dispose()
75:   }
76: 
77:   dispose() {
78:     this.group.traverse((o) => {
79:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose?.()
80:       if (o.material) {
81:         const ms = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]
82:         ms.forEach((m) => m.dispose?.())
83:       }
84:     })
85:   }
86: 
87:   center() {
88:     return new THREE.Vector3(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.y + (this.hitY || 1), this.group.position.z)
89:   }
90: }

141:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
142:       const a = (i / 7) * TAU
143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))
144:       feather.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.35, 0.55 + Math.sin(a * 2) * 0.08, -0.05)
145:       feather.rotation.z = Math.cos(a) * 0.9

151:     halo.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.2

173:     const p = this.game.player.position

175:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
176:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7

193:       this.group.position.z *= 24 / r

199:     // attack
200:     this.attackTimer -= dt
201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

218:     const dir = target.sub(origin).normalize()
219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })
220:     this.game.effects.flash(origin, 1.8, 0xff8ac4, 0.12)
221:   }

462:         this.stateT = 0.85
463:         this.game.audio.tone(180, 0.5, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.08, to: 90 })
464:       }
465:     } else if (this.state === 'windup') {
466:       this.group.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.age * 16)) * 0.06
467:       this.group.position.x -= (dx / dist) * 0.8 * dt
468:       this.group.position.z -= (dz / dist) * 0.8 * dt
469:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {
470:         this.state = 'charge'
471:         this.stateT = 0.95
472:         this.chargeDir.set(dx / dist, 0, dz / dist)
473:         this.game.effects.ring(this.group.position, { color: 0xff3d3d, from: 0.4, to: 3, life: 0.4, flat: true })
474:         this.game.audio.tone(90, 0.4, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.14, to: 220 })
475:       }
476:     } else if (this.state === 'charge') {
477:       const step = 16 * dt
478:       const before = this.group.position.clone()
479:       this.group.position.addScaledVector(this.chargeDir, step)
480:       this.group.position.y = 0
481:       this.game.world.collide(this.group.position, 1.0)
482:       const moved = before.distanceTo(this.group.position)
483:       if (dist < 2.4) {
484:         this.game.player.takeDamage(20, this.group.position)
485:         this.state = 'stun'
486:         this.stateT = 1.3
487:         this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), 0.8)
488:       } else if (moved < step * 0.55 || this.stateT <= 0) {
489:         this.state = 'stun'
490:         this.stateT = 1.4
491:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(this.center(), 16, { color: 0xffcf3f, color2: 0xff7a2e, speed: 6, spread: 0.7, life: 0.5, size: 0.5 })
492:         this.game.audio.tone(70, 0.3, { type: 'sine', gain: 0.2, to: 40 })
493:       }
494:     } else if (this.state === 'stun') {
495:       this.group.position.y = 0
496:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {
497:         this.state = 'idle'
498:         this.stateT = rand(1.2, 2.2)
499:       }
500:     }
501:     this.group.lookAt(p.x, this.group.position.y + 1, p.z)
502:   }
503: }

740: /* ====================================================== MANAGER */
741: export class EnemyManager {
742:   constructor(game) {
743:     this.game = game
744:     this.list = []
745:     this.projectiles = []
746:     this.shockwaves = []
747:     this.boss = null
748:   }
749: 
750:   reset() {
751:     for (const e of this.list) {
752:       this.game.world.scene.remove(e.group)
753:       e.dispose?.()
754:     }
755:     this.list.length = 0
756:     for (const p of this.projectiles) this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
757:     this.projectiles.length = 0
758:     for (const s of this.shockwaves) this.game.world.scene.remove(s.mesh)
759:     this.shockwaves.length = 0
760:     this.boss = null
761:   }
762: 
763:   spawn(type, pos) {
764:     let e
765:     if (type === 'mask') e = new Mask(this.game, pos)
766:     else if (type === 'saci') e = new Saci(this.game, pos)
767:     else if (type === 'boi') e = new Boi(this.game, pos)
768:     else if (type === 'boss') {
769:       e = new Boss(this.game, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -34))
770:       this.boss = e
771:     }
772:     if (e) this.list.push(e)
773:     return e
774:   }
775: 
776:   countOfType(type) {
777:     return this.list.filter((e) => !e.dead && e.type === type).length
778:   }
779: 
780:   aliveCount() {
781:     return this.list.filter((e) => !e.dead).length
782:   }
783: 
784:   spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed = 10, damage = 10, color = 0xff5aa8, owner = null } = {}) {
785:     const mesh = new THREE.Group()
786:     const orb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 8, 7), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color }))
787:     mesh.add(orb)
788:     const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
789:       map: glowTexture('rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', 'rgba(255,80,160,0)'),
790:       color, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
791:     }))
792:     glow.scale.set(1.4, 1.4, 1)
793:     mesh.add(glow)
794:     mesh.position.copy(origin)
795:     this.game.world.scene.add(mesh)
796:     this.projectiles.push({
797:       mesh, dir: dir.clone().normalize(), speed, damage, color, owner,
798:       life: 4.5, trail: 0,
799:     })
800:   }
801: 
802:   spawnShockwave(pos, { damage = 12, speed = 9, maxRadius = 34, color = 0xff3d8b } = {}) {
803:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
804:       color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
805:       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false,
806:     })
807:     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.92, 1, 64), mat)
808:     mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
809:     mesh.position.set(pos.x, 0.85, pos.z)
810:     mesh.scale.setScalar(1)
811:     this.game.world.scene.add(mesh)
812:     this.shockwaves.push({ mesh, radius: 1, speed, maxRadius, damage, hit: false, color })
813:   }
814: 
815:   raycast(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
816:     let best = null
817:     const center = new THREE.Vector3()
818:     for (const e of this.list) {
819:       if (e.dead) continue
820:       center.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z)
821:       const oc = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(center, origin)
822:       const tca = oc.dot(dir)
823:       if (tca < 0) continue
824:       const d2 = oc.lengthSq() - tca * tca
825:       const r2 = e.hitRadius * e.hitRadius
826:       if (d2 > r2) continue
827:       const thc = Math.sqrt(r2 - d2)
828:       const t = tca - thc
829:       if (t < 0 || t > maxDist) continue
830:       if (!best || t < best.dist) {
831:         best = {
832:           enemy: e,
833:           dist: t,
834:           point: origin.clone().addScaledVector(dir, t),
835:           center: center.clone(),
836:         }
837:       }
838:     }
839:     return best
840:   }
841: 
842:   findAimTarget(origin, dir, maxAngle = 0.1, maxDist = 70) {
843:     let best = null
844:     const to = new THREE.Vector3()
845:     for (const e of this.list) {
846:       if (e.dead) continue
847:       to.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z).sub(origin)
848:       const dist = to.length()
849:       if (dist > maxDist || dist < 0.1) continue
850:       to.divideScalar(dist)
851:       const ang = Math.acos(clamp(to.dot(dir), -1, 1))
852:       const allowance = Math.max(maxAngle, Math.atan2(e.hitRadius, dist) * 0.85)
853:       if (ang < allowance) {
854:         const weight = ang - (1 - dist / maxDist) * 0.004
855:         if (!best || weight < best.weight) best = { enemy: e, weight, angle: ang }
856:       }
857:     }
858:     return best
859:   }
860: 
861:   damageInRadius(pos, radius, damage, source = null) {
862:     let hits = 0
863:     for (const e of this.list) {
864:       if (e.dead) continue
865:       const c = e.center()
866:       const d = c.distanceTo(pos)
867:       if (d < radius + e.hitRadius) {
868:         const falloff = clamp(1 - d / (radius + e.hitRadius) * 0.55, 0.45, 1)
869:         e.takeDamage(damage * falloff, c)
870:         hits++
871:       }
872:     }
873:     return hits
874:   }
875: 
876:   update(dt) {
877:     for (const e of this.list) {
878:       if (!e.dead) e.update(dt)
879:     }
880:     // remove dead non-boss entries
881:     for (let i = this.list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
882:       const e = this.list[i]
883:       if (e.dead) {
884:         if (e.type === 'boss') this.boss = null
885:         this.list.splice(i, 1)
886:       }
887:     }
888: 
889:     // projectiles
890:     for (let i = this.projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
891:       const p = this.projectiles[i]
892:       p.life -= dt
893:       p.mesh.position.addScaledVector(p.dir, p.speed * dt)
894:       p.mesh.rotation.y += dt * 4
895:       p.trail -= dt
896:       if (p.trail <= 0) {
897:         p.trail = 0.04
898:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(p.mesh.position, 1, {
899:           color: p.color, color2: 0xffffff, speed: 0.6, spread: 0.05, life: 0.25,
900:           size: 0.35, gravity: 0, drag: 0.9,
901:         })
902:       }
903:       const pp = this.game.player.position
904:       const d = Math.hypot(p.mesh.position.x - pp.x, p.mesh.position.z - pp.z)
905:       const yHit = p.mesh.position.y > 0.4 && p.mesh.position.y < 2.3
906:       let remove = false
907:       if (d < 0.75 && yHit) {
908:         this.game.player.takeDamage(p.damage, p.mesh.position)
909:         this.game.effects.hit(p.mesh.position, p.color, 10)
910:         remove = true
911:       }
912:       if (p.life <= 0 || p.mesh.position.y < 0.1 || Math.hypot(p.mesh.position.x, p.mesh.position.z) > 32) remove = true
913:       if (remove) {
914:         this.game.effects.hit(p.mesh.position, p.color, 6)
915:         this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
916:         this.projectiles.splice(i, 1)
917:       }
918:     }
919: 
920:     // boss shockwaves
921:     const pp = this.game.player.position
922:     for (let i = this.shockwaves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
923:       const s = this.shockwaves[i]
924:       s.radius += s.speed * dt
925:       const k = s.radius / s.maxRadius
926:       s.mesh.scale.setScalar(s.radius)
927:       s.mesh.material.opacity = 0.85 * (1 - k) + 0.1
928:       if (!s.hit) {
929:         const d = Math.hypot(pp.x - s.mesh.position.x, pp.z - s.mesh.position.z)
930:         if (Math.abs(d - s.radius) < 1.0) {
931:           const dealt = this.game.player.takeDamage(s.damage, s.mesh.position)
932:           if (dealt > 0) {
933:             s.hit = true
934:             this.game.effects.hit(this.game.player.eyePosition, 0xff3d8b, 12)
935:           }
936:         }
937:       }
938:       if (s.radius > s.maxRadius) {

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the main game, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, and styling files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace the game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs in the inspected files.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address clear or measured sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, and pickup files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the requested gameplay and performance improvements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace the game loop, Saci death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs in the inspected files.
2. Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address clear or measured sources of choppiness, then run and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, and pickup files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs in the inspected files.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, and pickup files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs in the inspected files.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Read the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, and pickup files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Trace the relevant flows and implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

177:     const nx = dx / dist

180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, pickup, and README files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Trace the reward, firing/switching, and input/UI flows; implement the crate, hidden spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, pickup, and README files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Trace the reward, firing/switching, and input/UI flows; implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Read the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, pickup, and README files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Trace the reward, firing/switching, and input/UI flows; implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Read the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, pickup, and README files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Trace the reward, firing/switching, and input/UI flows; implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

141:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
142:       const a = (i / 7) * TAU
143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))

151:     halo.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.2

171:     this.spawnScale = this.spawnT
172:     this.updateFlash(dt)
173:     const p = this.game.player.position
174:     const dx = p.x - this.group.position.x
175:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
176:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7
187:     const tl = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1
188:     this.group.position.x += (tx / tl) * speed * dt
189:     this.group.position.z += (tz / tl) * speed * dt
190:     const r = Math.hypot(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.z)
191:     if (r > 24) {
192:       this.group.position.x *= 24 / r
193:       this.group.position.z *= 24 / r

195:     this.group.position.y = this.baseY + Math.sin(this.age * 1.6 + this.hitRadius) * 0.22

197:     this.halo.rotation.z += dt * 1.4

199:     // attack
200:     this.attackTimer -= dt
201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })

221:   }

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Read the game loop, enemy, weapon, input, UI, markup, styling, pickup, and README files; no files were changed.

### Active
- Trace the reward, firing/switching, and input/UI flows; implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve clear or measured sources of choppiness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Trace Saci’s death/reward flow, weapon firing/switching, and input/UI APIs.
2. Implement the crate, spin/reward, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
3. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, game state, waves, and system wiring.
- `src/enemies.js`: Enemy behavior and Saci defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning and collection.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

31: class Enemy {
32:   constructor(game, type, pos) {
33:     this.game = game
34:     this.type = type
35:     this.dead = false
36:     this.flash = 0
37:     this.spawnT = 0
38:     this.age = 0
39:     this.attackTimer = rand(0.8, 2.2)
40:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
41:     this.group.position.copy(pos)
42:     this.baseY = 0
43:     this.knock = new THREE.Vector3()
44:     this.materials = []
45:   }
46: 
47:   addMat(m) { this.materials.push(m); return m }
48: 
49:   updateFlash(dt) {
50:     this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 4)
51:     const s = 1 + this.flash * 0.09
52:     this.group.scale.setScalar(this.spawnScale * s)
53:   }
54: 
55:   takeDamage(amount, point) {
56:     if (this.dead || this.dying) return false
57:     this.hp -= amount
58:     this.flash = 1
59:     this.game.effects.hit(point || this.center(), this.hitColor || 0xffd76a, 6)
60:     this.game.audio.hit()
61:     if (this.hp <= 0) {
62:       this.die()
63:       return true
64:     }
65:     return false
66:   }
67: 
68:   die() {
69:     this.dead = true
70:     this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), this.type === 'boi' ? 1.5 : 1)
71:     this.game.audio.kill()
72:     this.game.onEnemyKilled?.(this)
73:     this.game.world.scene.remove(this.group)
74:     this.dispose()
75:   }
76: 
77:   dispose() {
78:     this.group.traverse((o) => {
79:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose?.()
80:       if (o.material) {
81:         const ms = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]
82:         ms.forEach((m) => m.dispose?.())
83:       }
84:     })
85:   }
86: 
87:   center() {
88:     return new THREE.Vector3(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.y + (this.hitY || 1), this.group.position.z)
89:   }
90: }

141:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
142:       const a = (i / 7) * TAU
143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))
144:       feather.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.35, 0.55 + Math.sin(a * 2) * 0.08, -0.05)

151:     halo.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.2

156:     const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({

173:     const p = this.game.player.position

175:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
176:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7
