199:     // attack
200:     this.attackTimer -= dt
201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

218:     const dir = target.sub(origin).normalize()
219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })
220:     this.game.effects.flash(origin, 1.8, 0xff8ac4, 0.12)
221:   }

339:   makePalm(x, z, scale = 1, tint = 1) {
340:     const g = new THREE.Group()
341:     const trunkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(0x6b4a32).multiplyScalar(tint) })
342:     let y = 0
343:     let offX = 0
344:     for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
345:       const seg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18 * scale, 0.26 * scale, 1.7 * scale, 6), trunkMat)
346:       offX += 0.12 * scale
347:       seg.position.set(offX * i * 0.4, y + 0.85 * scale, 0)
348:       seg.rotation.z = -0.05 - i * 0.02
349:       g.add(seg)
350:       y += 1.6 * scale
351:     }
352:     const leafMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(0x1f5d3a).multiplyScalar(tint), flatShading: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
353:     for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
354:       const a = (i / 9) * TAU
355:       const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.42 * scale, 3.4 * scale, 3), leafMat)
356:       leaf.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 1.1 * scale, y + 0.35 * scale, Math.sin(a) * 1.1 * scale)
357:       leaf.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2 - 0.5
358:       leaf.rotation.y = -a
359:       leaf.rotation.x = 0.2
360:       g.add(leaf)
361:     }
362:     const coconutMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4a3a22 })
363:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
364:       const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16 * scale, 6, 5), coconutMat)
365:       const a = rand(0, TAU)
366:       c.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.45 * scale, y - 0.1 * scale, Math.sin(a) * 0.45 * scale)
367:       g.add(c)
368:     }
369:     g.position.set(x, 0, z)
370:     this.scene.add(g)
371:     if (tint > 0.4) this.addCollider(x, z, 0.55 * scale, 6 * scale)
372:     return g
373:   }

729:     for (const c of this.colliders) {

732:       const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
733:       const min = c.r + radius
734:       if (d < min && d > 0.0001) {

736:         pos.x += dx * push
737:         pos.z += dz * push

744:   rayDistance(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
745:     let best = maxDist

747:       const t = -origin.y / dir.y
748:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) best = t
749:     }
750:     for (const c of this.colliders) {

752:       const oz = origin.z - c.z
753:       const a = dir.x * dir.x + dir.z * dir.z
754:       if (a < 1e-6) continue

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy and weapon systems, controls, UI, pickups, and world updates.
- No files have been changed.

### Active
- Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve sources of choppiness, then verify the game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
2. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Enemy-kill and pickup callbacks, game state, and update/render loop.
- `src/enemies.js`: Saci behavior, health, movement, and defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon inventory, firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning, animation, and collection.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.
- `src/world.js`: World construction and per-frame animated updates.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Keyboard `1`/`2` currently both enqueue a weapon switch rather than selecting a specific slot.
- Saci currently has 20 HP and moves at 4.4 units/s while rushing toward the player.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- `package.json` was not found.

143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))

177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7

201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })
220:     this.game.effects.flash(origin, 1.8, 0xff8ac4, 0.12)
221:   }

339:   makePalm(x, z, scale = 1, tint = 1) {
340:     const g = new THREE.Group()
341:     const trunkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(0x6b4a32).multiplyScalar(tint) })
342:     let y = 0
343:     let offX = 0
344:     for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
345:       const seg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18 * scale, 0.26 * scale, 1.7 * scale, 6), trunkMat)
346:       offX += 0.12 * scale
347:       seg.position.set(offX * i * 0.4, y + 0.85 * scale, 0)
348:       seg.rotation.z = -0.05 - i * 0.02
349:       g.add(seg)
350:       y += 1.6 * scale
351:     }
352:     const leafMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(0x1f5d3a).multiplyScalar(tint), flatShading: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
353:     for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
354:       const a = (i / 9) * TAU
355:       const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.42 * scale, 3.4 * scale, 3), leafMat)
356:       leaf.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 1.1 * scale, y + 0.35 * scale, Math.sin(a) * 1.1 * scale)
357:       leaf.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2 - 0.5
358:       leaf.rotation.y = -a
359:       leaf.rotation.x = 0.2
360:       g.add(leaf)
361:     }
362:     const coconutMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4a3a22 })
363:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
364:       const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16 * scale, 6, 5), coconutMat)
365:       const a = rand(0, TAU)
366:       c.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.45 * scale, y - 0.1 * scale, Math.sin(a) * 0.45 * scale)
367:       g.add(c)
368:     }
369:     g.position.set(x, 0, z)
370:     this.scene.add(g)
371:     if (tint > 0.4) this.addCollider(x, z, 0.55 * scale, 6 * scale)
372:     return g
373:   }

722:   collide(pos, radius) {
723:     const len = Math.hypot(pos.x, pos.z)
724:     const max = this.bounds - radius
725:     if (len > max) {
726:       pos.x = (pos.x / len) * max
727:       pos.z = (pos.z / len) * max
728:     }
729:     for (const c of this.colliders) {
730:       const dx = pos.x - c.x
731:       const dz = pos.z - c.z
732:       const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
733:       const min = c.r + radius
734:       if (d < min && d > 0.0001) {
735:         const push = (min - d) / d
736:         pos.x += dx * push
737:         pos.z += dz * push
738:       } else if (d <= 0.0001) {
739:         pos.x += min
740:       }
741:     }
742:   }

744:   rayDistance(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
745:     let best = maxDist
746:     if (dir.y < -0.0001) {
747:       const t = -origin.y / dir.y
748:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) best = t
749:     }
750:     for (const c of this.colliders) {
751:       const ox = origin.x - c.x
752:       const oz = origin.z - c.z
753:       const a = dir.x * dir.x + dir.z * dir.z
754:       if (a < 1e-6) continue
755:       const b = 2 * (ox * dir.x + oz * dir.z)
756:       const cc = ox * ox + oz * oz - c.r * c.r
757:       const disc = b * b - 4 * a * cc
758:       if (disc < 0) continue
759:       const t = (-b - Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a)
760:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) {
761:         const y = origin.y + dir.y * t
762:         if (y >= 0 && y <= c.h) best = t
763:       }
764:     }
765:     return best
766:   }

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game loop, enemy and weapon systems, controls, UI, pickups, and world updates.
- No files have been changed.

### Active
- Implement the reward crate and spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve sources of choppiness, then verify the game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
2. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Enemy-kill and pickup callbacks, game state, and update/render loop.
- `src/enemies.js`: Saci behavior, health, movement, and defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon inventory, firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/pickups.js`: Existing pickup spawning, animation, and collection.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.
- `src/world.js`: World construction and per-frame animated updates.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Keyboard `1`/`2` currently both enqueue a weapon switch rather than selecting a specific slot.
- Saci currently has 20 HP and moves at 4.4 units/s while rushing toward the player.
- Potential per-frame performance costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are source-based hypotheses, not benchmark results.

## Findings

### Reward drops and pickups

- There is **no reward-crate mechanic** in the pickup system: [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/pickups.js`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/pickups.js ) defines floating pickups (`acai`, `shield`, `rapid`, and the default coin), but no crate type. The “crates” found in [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js#L563 ) are scenery meshes.
- The pickup API is `PickupManager.spawn(type, pos)`; it creates and adds the pickup group to the world scene ([`pickups.js:19–83`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/pickups.js#L19 )). Collection occurs within 1.5 units and calls `game.onPickup(p.type)` ([`pickups.js:85–103`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/pickups.js#L85 )).
- Enemy-drop rules live in `Game.onEnemyKilled` in [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L420 ): Boi enemies drop an açaí and a second random pickup; other enemies have a 14% drop chance, raised to 18% for Saci ([`main.js:429–440`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L429 )).
- Pickup rewards are applied centrally in `Game.onPickup`: açaí heals and awards score, shield adds shield, rapid fire lasts eight seconds, and coins award points ([`main.js:443–460`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L443 )).
- **Safe insertion point for crate rewards:** add the crate’s spawn/interaction flow alongside pickup management, and route the reward through `onPickup` or a similarly centralized callback. For wave-clear or boss rewards, `updateWaves` and `spawnBoss` are relevant orchestration points ([`main.js:349–417`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js#L349 )).

### Weapon selection

- `WeaponSystem` declares two weapons, `berimbau` and `foguete`, and tracks the selected index in `current` ([`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js:5–19`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L5 )).
- `setWeapon(index)` updates the active weapon model, plays the switch sound, and notifies `onWeaponChange`; `switchWeapon()` cycles between the two ([`weapons.js:153–165`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L153 )). The system consumes input and processes switching in `update` ([`weapons.js:188–213`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js#L188 )).
- Keyboard Q/Tab and the touch switch button queue a switch. **Both number keys 1 and 2 currently queue the same cycle operation**, rather than selecting a specific slot ([`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js:39–50`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js#L39 )). `consumeSwitch()` clears that queued action ([`input.js:306–310`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js#L306 )).
- The HUD reads `weapons.current` and updates the name and selected slot in `updateHUD` ([`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js:76–109`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js#L76 )).
- **Safe insertion point for direct slot selection:** add a distinct selection input/API and route it through `setWeapon(index)`, preserving the existing cycle behavior for Q/Tab and the touch switch control.

### Saci behavior

- Saci initialization, stats, and model construction are in [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js#L225 ).

12:     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {

14:       ctx.beginPath()
15:       const x = i * 28
16:       ctx.moveTo(x, h / 2)
17:       ctx.lineTo(x + 14, h / 2 - 22)
18:       ctx.lineTo(x + 28, h / 2)
19:       ctx.lineTo(x + 14, h / 2 + 22)

23:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'
24:     for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) ctx.fillRect(rand(0, w), rand(0, h), 2, 2)
25:   })
26:   boiTexture.wrapS = boiTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
27:   boiTexture.repeat.set(2, 1)

31: class Enemy {
32:   constructor(game, type, pos) {
33:     this.game = game
34:     this.type = type
35:     this.dead = false
36:     this.flash = 0
37:     this.spawnT = 0
38:     this.age = 0
39:     this.attackTimer = rand(0.8, 2.2)
40:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
41:     this.group.position.copy(pos)
42:     this.baseY = 0
43:     this.knock = new THREE.Vector3()
44:     this.materials = []
45:   }
46: 
47:   addMat(m) { this.materials.push(m); return m }
48: 
49:   updateFlash(dt) {
50:     this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 4)
51:     const s = 1 + this.flash * 0.09
52:     this.group.scale.setScalar(this.spawnScale * s)
53:   }
54: 
55:   takeDamage(amount, point) {
56:     if (this.dead || this.dying) return false
57:     this.hp -= amount
58:     this.flash = 1
59:     this.game.effects.hit(point || this.center(), this.hitColor || 0xffd76a, 6)
60:     this.game.audio.hit()
61:     if (this.hp <= 0) {
62:       this.die()
63:       return true
64:     }
65:     return false
66:   }
67: 
68:   die() {
69:     this.dead = true
70:     this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), this.type === 'boi' ? 1.5 : 1)
71:     this.game.audio.kill()
72:     this.game.onEnemyKilled?.(this)
73:     this.game.world.scene.remove(this.group)
74:     this.dispose()
75:   }
76: 
77:   dispose() {
78:     this.group.traverse((o) => {
79:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose?.()
80:       if (o.material) {
81:         const ms = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]
82:         ms.forEach((m) => m.dispose?.())
83:       }
84:     })
85:   }
86: 
87:   center() {
88:     return new THREE.Vector3(this.group.position.x, this.group.position.y + (this.hitY || 1), this.group.position.z)
89:   }
90: }

141:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
142:       const a = (i / 7) * TAU
143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))
144:       feather.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.35, 0.55 + Math.sin(a * 2) * 0.08, -0.05)
145:       feather.rotation.z = Math.cos(a) * 0.9

150:     const halo = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.75, 0.025, 4, 32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff5aa8, transparent: true, opacity: 0.65 }))
151:     halo.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.2
152:     halo.position.z = -0.15
153:     this.group.add(halo)
154:     this.halo = halo

156:     const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
157:       map: glowTexture('rgba(255,120,190,0.85)', 'rgba(255,40,120,0)'),

173:     const p = this.game.player.position
174:     const dx = p.x - this.group.position.x
175:     const dz = p.z - this.group.position.z
176:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 0.001
177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7
187:     const tl = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1

189:     this.group.position.z += (tz / tl) * speed * dt

191:     if (r > 24) {

193:       this.group.position.z *= 24 / r

197:     this.halo.rotation.z += dt * 1.4

199:     // attack
200:     this.attackTimer -= dt
201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

215:   fire() {
216:     const origin = this.center()
217:     const target = this.game.player.eyePosition
218:     const dir = target.sub(origin).normalize()
219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })
220:     this.game.effects.flash(origin, 1.8, 0xff8ac4, 0.12)
221:   }

461:         this.state = 'windup'
462:         this.stateT = 0.85
463:         this.game.audio.tone(180, 0.5, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.08, to: 90 })
464:       }
465:     } else if (this.state === 'windup') {
466:       this.group.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.age * 16)) * 0.06
467:       this.group.position.x -= (dx / dist) * 0.8 * dt
468:       this.group.position.z -= (dz / dist) * 0.8 * dt
469:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {
470:         this.state = 'charge'
471:         this.stateT = 0.95
472:         this.chargeDir.set(dx / dist, 0, dz / dist)
473:         this.game.effects.ring(this.group.position, { color: 0xff3d3d, from: 0.4, to: 3, life: 0.4, flat: true })
474:         this.game.audio.tone(90, 0.4, { type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.14, to: 220 })
475:       }
476:     } else if (this.state === 'charge') {
477:       const step = 16 * dt
478:       const before = this.group.position.clone()
479:       this.group.position.addScaledVector(this.chargeDir, step)
480:       this.group.position.y = 0
481:       this.game.world.collide(this.group.position, 1.0)
482:       const moved = before.distanceTo(this.group.position)
483:       if (dist < 2.4) {
484:         this.game.player.takeDamage(20, this.group.position)
485:         this.state = 'stun'
486:         this.stateT = 1.3
487:         this.game.effects.explosion(this.center(), 0.8)
488:       } else if (moved < step * 0.55 || this.stateT <= 0) {
489:         this.state = 'stun'
490:         this.stateT = 1.4
491:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(this.center(), 16, { color: 0xffcf3f, color2: 0xff7a2e, speed: 6, spread: 0.7, life: 0.5, size: 0.5 })
492:         this.game.audio.tone(70, 0.3, { type: 'sine', gain: 0.2, to: 40 })
493:       }
494:     } else if (this.state === 'stun') {
495:       this.group.position.y = 0
496:       if (this.stateT <= 0) {
497:         this.state = 'idle'
498:         this.stateT = rand(1.2, 2.2)
499:       }
500:     }
501:     this.group.lookAt(p.x, this.group.position.y + 1, p.z)
502:   }
503: }

740: /* ====================================================== MANAGER */
741: export class EnemyManager {
742:   constructor(game) {
743:     this.game = game
744:     this.list = []
745:     this.projectiles = []
746:     this.shockwaves = []
747:     this.boss = null
748:   }
749: 
750:   reset() {
751:     for (const e of this.list) {
752:       this.game.world.scene.remove(e.group)
753:       e.dispose?.()
754:     }
755:     this.list.length = 0
756:     for (const p of this.projectiles) this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
757:     this.projectiles.length = 0
758:     for (const s of this.shockwaves) this.game.world.scene.remove(s.mesh)
759:     this.shockwaves.length = 0
760:     this.boss = null
761:   }
762: 
763:   spawn(type, pos) {
764:     let e
765:     if (type === 'mask') e = new Mask(this.game, pos)
766:     else if (type === 'saci') e = new Saci(this.game, pos)
767:     else if (type === 'boi') e = new Boi(this.game, pos)
768:     else if (type === 'boss') {
769:       e = new Boss(this.game, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -34))
770:       this.boss = e
771:     }
772:     if (e) this.list.push(e)
773:     return e
774:   }
775: 
776:   countOfType(type) {
777:     return this.list.filter((e) => !e.dead && e.type === type).length
778:   }
779: 
780:   aliveCount() {
781:     return this.list.filter((e) => !e.dead).length
782:   }
783: 
784:   spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed = 10, damage = 10, color = 0xff5aa8, owner = null } = {}) {
785:     const mesh = new THREE.Group()
786:     const orb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 8, 7), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color }))
787:     mesh.add(orb)
788:     const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
789:       map: glowTexture('rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', 'rgba(255,80,160,0)'),
790:       color, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
791:     }))
792:     glow.scale.set(1.4, 1.4, 1)
793:     mesh.add(glow)
794:     mesh.position.copy(origin)
795:     this.game.world.scene.add(mesh)
796:     this.projectiles.push({
797:       mesh, dir: dir.clone().normalize(), speed, damage, color, owner,
798:       life: 4.5, trail: 0,
799:     })
800:   }
801: 
802:   spawnShockwave(pos, { damage = 12, speed = 9, maxRadius = 34, color = 0xff3d8b } = {}) {
803:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
804:       color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
805:       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false,
806:     })
807:     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.92, 1, 64), mat)
808:     mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
809:     mesh.position.set(pos.x, 0.85, pos.z)
810:     mesh.scale.setScalar(1)
811:     this.game.world.scene.add(mesh)
812:     this.shockwaves.push({ mesh, radius: 1, speed, maxRadius, damage, hit: false, color })
813:   }
814: 
815:   raycast(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
816:     let best = null
817:     const center = new THREE.Vector3()
818:     for (const e of this.list) {
819:       if (e.dead) continue
820:       center.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z)
821:       const oc = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(center, origin)
822:       const tca = oc.dot(dir)
823:       if (tca < 0) continue
824:       const d2 = oc.lengthSq() - tca * tca
825:       const r2 = e.hitRadius * e.hitRadius
826:       if (d2 > r2) continue
827:       const thc = Math.sqrt(r2 - d2)
828:       const t = tca - thc
829:       if (t < 0 || t > maxDist) continue
830:       if (!best || t < best.dist) {
831:         best = {
832:           enemy: e,
833:           dist: t,
834:           point: origin.clone().addScaledVector(dir, t),
835:           center: center.clone(),
836:         }
837:       }
838:     }
839:     return best
840:   }
841: 
842:   findAimTarget(origin, dir, maxAngle = 0.1, maxDist = 70) {
843:     let best = null
844:     const to = new THREE.Vector3()
845:     for (const e of this.list) {
846:       if (e.dead) continue
847:       to.set(e.group.position.x, e.group.position.y + e.hitY, e.group.position.z).sub(origin)
848:       const dist = to.length()
849:       if (dist > maxDist || dist < 0.1) continue
850:       to.divideScalar(dist)
851:       const ang = Math.acos(clamp(to.dot(dir), -1, 1))
852:       const allowance = Math.max(maxAngle, Math.atan2(e.hitRadius, dist) * 0.85)
853:       if (ang < allowance) {
854:         const weight = ang - (1 - dist / maxDist) * 0.004
855:         if (!best || weight < best.weight) best = { enemy: e, weight, angle: ang }
856:       }
857:     }
858:     return best
859:   }
860: 
861:   damageInRadius(pos, radius, damage, source = null) {
862:     let hits = 0
863:     for (const e of this.list) {
864:       if (e.dead) continue
865:       const c = e.center()
866:       const d = c.distanceTo(pos)
867:       if (d < radius + e.hitRadius) {
868:         const falloff = clamp(1 - d / (radius + e.hitRadius) * 0.55, 0.45, 1)
869:         e.takeDamage(damage * falloff, c)
870:         hits++
871:       }
872:     }
873:     return hits
874:   }
875: 
876:   update(dt) {
877:     for (const e of this.list) {
878:       if (!e.dead) e.update(dt)
879:     }
880:     // remove dead non-boss entries
881:     for (let i = this.list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
882:       const e = this.list[i]
883:       if (e.dead) {
884:         if (e.type === 'boss') this.boss = null
885:         this.list.splice(i, 1)
886:       }
887:     }
888: 
889:     // projectiles
890:     for (let i = this.projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
891:       const p = this.projectiles[i]
892:       p.life -= dt
893:       p.mesh.position.addScaledVector(p.dir, p.speed * dt)
894:       p.mesh.rotation.y += dt * 4
895:       p.trail -= dt
896:       if (p.trail <= 0) {
897:         p.trail = 0.04
898:         this.game.effects.spawnParticles(p.mesh.position, 1, {
899:           color: p.color, color2: 0xffffff, speed: 0.6, spread: 0.05, life: 0.25,
900:           size: 0.35, gravity: 0, drag: 0.9,
901:         })
902:       }
903:       const pp = this.game.player.position
904:       const d = Math.hypot(p.mesh.position.x - pp.x, p.mesh.position.z - pp.z)
905:       const yHit = p.mesh.position.y > 0.4 && p.mesh.position.y < 2.3
906:       let remove = false
907:       if (d < 0.75 && yHit) {
908:         this.game.player.takeDamage(p.damage, p.mesh.position)
909:         this.game.effects.hit(p.mesh.position, p.color, 10)
910:         remove = true
911:       }
912:       if (p.life <= 0 || p.mesh.position.y < 0.1 || Math.hypot(p.mesh.position.x, p.mesh.position.z) > 32) remove = true
913:       if (remove) {
914:         this.game.effects.hit(p.mesh.position, p.color, 6)
915:         this.game.world.scene.remove(p.mesh)
916:         this.projectiles.splice(i, 1)
917:       }
918:     }
919: 
920:     // boss shockwaves
921:     const pp = this.game.player.position
922:     for (let i = this.shockwaves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
923:       const s = this.shockwaves[i]
924:       s.radius += s.speed * dt
925:       const k = s.radius / s.maxRadius
926:       s.mesh.scale.setScalar(s.radius)
927:       s.mesh.material.opacity = 0.85 * (1 - k) + 0.1
928:       if (!s.hit) {
929:         const d = Math.hypot(pp.x - s.mesh.position.x, pp.z - s.mesh.position.z)
930:         if (Math.abs(d - s.radius) < 1.0) {
931:           const dealt = this.game.player.takeDamage(s.damage, s.mesh.position)
932:           if (dealt > 0) {
933:             s.hit = true
934:             this.game.effects.hit(this.game.player.eyePosition, 0xff3d8b, 12)
935:           }
936:         }

721:   /* ---------------------------------------------------- gameplay */
722:   collide(pos, radius) {
723:     const len = Math.hypot(pos.x, pos.z)
724:     const max = this.bounds - radius
725:     if (len > max) {
726:       pos.x = (pos.x / len) * max
727:       pos.z = (pos.z / len) * max
728:     }
729:     for (const c of this.colliders) {
730:       const dx = pos.x - c.x
731:       const dz = pos.z - c.z
732:       const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
733:       const min = c.r + radius
734:       if (d < min && d > 0.0001) {
735:         const push = (min - d) / d
736:         pos.x += dx * push
737:         pos.z += dz * push
738:       } else if (d <= 0.0001) {
739:         pos.x += min
740:       }
741:     }
742:   }

744:   rayDistance(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
745:     let best = maxDist
746:     if (dir.y < -0.0001) {
747:       const t = -origin.y / dir.y
748:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) best = t
749:     }
750:     for (const c of this.colliders) {
751:       const ox = origin.x - c.x
752:       const oz = origin.z - c.z
753:       const a = dir.x * dir.x + dir.z * dir.z
754:       if (a < 1e-6) continue
755:       const b = 2 * (ox * dir.x + oz * dir.z)
756:       const cc = ox * ox + oz * oz - c.r * c.r
757:       const disc = b * b - 4 * a * cc
758:       if (disc < 0) continue
759:       const t = (-b - Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a)
760:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) {
761:         const y = origin.y + dir.y * t
762:         if (y >= 0 && y <= c.h) best = t
763:       }
764:     }
765:     return best
766:   }

772:       p.z += rand(-1.4, 1.4)
773:       this.collide(p, 0.8)
774:       return p
775:     }
776:     return new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -23)
777:   }

779:   /* ------------------------------------------------------- update */
780:   update(dt, playerPos) {
781:     this.time += dt
782:     const t = this.time
783: 
784:     // flags flutter
785:     if (this.bunting) {
786:       const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
787:       for (let i = 0; i < this.buntingData.length; i++) {
788:         const f = this.buntingData[i]
789:         dummy.position.copy(f.base)
790:         dummy.position.y += Math.sin(t * 1.7 + f.phase) * f.amp
791:         dummy.rotation.set(Math.sin(t * 1.3 + f.phase) * 0.08, Math.sin(t * 0.9 + f.phase) * 0.18, Math.sin(t * 1.6 + f.phase) * 0.1)
792:         dummy.updateMatrix()
793:         this.bunting.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
794:       }
795:       this.bunting.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true
796:     }
797: 
798:     // fire
799:     if (this.fireParticles) {
800:       const { points, seed, base } = this.fireParticles
801:       const arr = points.geometry.attributes.position.array
802:       for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) {
803:         const s = seed[i]
804:         s.life += dt * s.speed
805:         if (s.life > 1) {
806:           s.life -= 1
807:           s.x = rand(-0.55, 0.55)
808:           s.z = rand(-0.55, 0.55)
809:         }
810:         const life = s.life
811:         arr[i * 3] = base.x + s.x + Math.sin(t * 3 + s.sway) * life * 0.45
812:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = base.y + life * 3.4
813:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = base.z + s.z + Math.cos(t * 2.6 + s.sway) * life * 0.45
814:       }
815:       points.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
816:       points.material.opacity = 0.85
817:     }
818:     for (const l of this.animatedLights) {
819:       l.light.intensity = l.base + Math.sin(t * l.speed) * l.base * 0.18 + Math.sin(t * 13.7) * 1.6
820:     }
821: 
822:     // fireflies
823:     if (this.fireflies) {
824:       const { points, seeds } = this.fireflies
825:       const arr = points.geometry.attributes.position.array
826:       for (let i = 0; i < seeds.length; i++) {
827:         const s = seeds[i]
828:         s.a += dt * s.sp * 0.35
829:         arr[i * 3] = Math.cos(s.a) * s.r + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + s.ph) * 1.2
830:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = s.y + Math.sin(t * 1.4 + s.ph) * 0.5
831:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(s.a) * s.r + Math.cos(t * 0.7 + s.ph) * 1.2
832:       }
833:       points.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
834:     }
835: 
836:     // capybara watches the guardian
837:     if (this.capybara && playerPos) {
838:       const dx = playerPos.x - this.capybara.position.x
839:       const dz = playerPos.z - this.capybara.position.z
840:       const target = Math.atan2(dz, dx)
841:       this.capyLook += (target - this.capyLook) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.2)
842:       this.capybara.rotation.y = this.capyLook
843:       this.capyHead.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.12
844:       this.capySnout.position.y = 0.8 + Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.015
845:     }
846:   }
847: }

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game-loop, enemy, weapon, input, pickup, UI, and world systems; identified implementation points and potential performance costs.
- No files have been changed.

### Active
- Implement the reward crate and spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve sources of choppiness, then verify the game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
2. Address performance issues and run/verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Enemy-kill and pickup callbacks, game state, update/render loop.
- `src/enemies.js`: Saci behavior, health, movement, and defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon inventory, firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/pickups.js`: Pickup spawning, animation, and collection.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.
- `src/world.js`: World construction and per-frame animated updates.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Keyboard `1`/`2` currently both enqueue a weapon switch rather than selecting a specific slot.
- Saci currently has 20 HP and moves at 4.4 units/s while rushing toward the player.
- `PickupManager.spawn(type, pos)` creates pickups; collection invokes `game.onPickup(p.type)`. No reward-crate pickup exists yet.
- Potential per-frame costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are hypotheses, not benchmark results. An automatic quality fallback lowers quality below 38 FPS.

143:       const feather = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, rand(0.7, 1.1), 4), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: pick(featherCols), emissive: 0x221018, emissiveIntensity: 0.4 }))

177:     const nx = dx / dist
178:     const nz = dz / dist
179: 
180:     // keep preferred distance and orbit
181:     let radial = 0
182:     if (dist > this.preferred + 2) radial = 1
183:     else if (dist < this.preferred - 2) radial = -1
184:     const speed = 2.6
185:     const tx = nx * radial + -nz * this.orbitDir * 0.7
186:     const tz = nz * radial + nx * this.orbitDir * 0.7

201:     if (this.attackTimer <= 0 && this.warn <= 0) {
202:       this.warn = 0.55
203:     }
204:     if (this.warn > 0) {
205:       this.warn -= dt
206:       this.halo.scale.setScalar(1 + (1 - this.warn / 0.55) * 0.5)
207:       if (this.warn <= 0) {
208:         this.halo.scale.setScalar(1)
209:         this.fire()
210:         this.attackTimer = rand(2.9, 4.1)
211:       }
212:     }
213:   }

219:     this.game.enemies.spawnProjectile(origin, dir, { speed: 9.2, damage: 8, color: 0xff5aa8, owner: this })
220:     this.game.effects.flash(origin, 1.8, 0xff8ac4, 0.12)
221:   }

339:   makePalm(x, z, scale = 1, tint = 1) {

346:       offX += 0.12 * scale
347:       seg.position.set(offX * i * 0.4, y + 0.85 * scale, 0)
348:       seg.rotation.z = -0.05 - i * 0.02
349:       g.add(seg)
350:       y += 1.6 * scale
351:     }
352:     const leafMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(0x1f5d3a).multiplyScalar(tint), flatShading: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
353:     for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {

357:       leaf.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2 - 0.5
358:       leaf.rotation.y = -a
359:       leaf.rotation.x = 0.2
360:       g.add(leaf)

363:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

722:   collide(pos, radius) {
723:     const len = Math.hypot(pos.x, pos.z)
724:     const max = this.bounds - radius
725:     if (len > max) {
726:       pos.x = (pos.x / len) * max
727:       pos.z = (pos.z / len) * max
728:     }
729:     for (const c of this.colliders) {
730:       const dx = pos.x - c.x
731:       const dz = pos.z - c.z
732:       const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
733:       const min = c.r + radius
734:       if (d < min && d > 0.0001) {
735:         const push = (min - d) / d
736:         pos.x += dx * push
737:         pos.z += dz * push

744:   rayDistance(origin, dir, maxDist = 70) {
745:     let best = maxDist
746:     if (dir.y < -0.0001) {
747:       const t = -origin.y / dir.y
748:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) best = t
749:     }
750:     for (const c of this.colliders) {
751:       const ox = origin.x - c.x
752:       const oz = origin.z - c.z
753:       const a = dir.x * dir.x + dir.z * dir.z
754:       if (a < 1e-6) continue
755:       const b = 2 * (ox * dir.x + oz * dir.z)
756:       const cc = ox * ox + oz * oz - c.r * c.r
757:       const disc = b * b - 4 * a * cc
758:       if (disc < 0) continue
759:       const t = (-b - Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a)
760:       if (t > 0.05 && t < best) {
761:         const y = origin.y + dir.y * t
762:         if (y >= 0 && y <= c.h) best = t
763:       }

765:     return best

809:         }
810:         const life = s.life
811:         arr[i * 3] = base.x + s.x + Math.sin(t * 3 + s.sway) * life * 0.45
812:         arr[i * 3 + 1] = base.y + life * 3.4
813:         arr[i * 3 + 2] = base.z + s.z + Math.cos(t * 2.6 + s.sway) * life * 0.45

817:     }
818:     for (const l of this.animatedLights) {

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game-loop, enemy, weapon, input, pickup, UI, and world systems; identified potential performance costs to investigate.
### Active
- Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve sources of choppiness, then verify the game.
### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
2. Investigate performance, make improvements, and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Enemy-kill and pickup callbacks, game state, update/render loop.
- `src/enemies.js`: Saci behavior, health, movement, and defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon inventory, firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/pickups.js`: Pickup spawning, animation, and collection.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.
- `src/world.js`: World construction and per-frame animated updates.

## Important Context
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Keyboard `1`/`2` currently both enqueue a weapon switch rather than selecting a specific slot.
- Saci currently has 20 HP and moves at 4.4 units/s while rushing toward the player.
- `PickupManager.spawn(type, pos)` creates pickups; collection invokes `game.onPickup(p.type)`. No reward-crate pickup exists yet.
- Potential per-frame costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are hypotheses, not benchmark results.
- No files have been changed.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game-loop, enemy, weapon, input, pickup, UI, and world systems.

### Active
- Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve sources of choppiness, then verify the game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
2. Investigate performance, make improvements, and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Enemy-kill and pickup callbacks, game state, update/render loop.
- `src/enemies.js`: Saci behavior, health, movement, and defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon inventory, firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/pickups.js`: Pickup spawning, animation, and collection.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.
- `src/world.js`: World construction and per-frame animated updates.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Keyboard `1`/`2` currently both enqueue a weapon switch rather than selecting a specific slot.
- Saci currently has 20 HP and moves at 4.4 units/s while rushing toward the player.
- `PickupManager.spawn(type, pos)` creates pickups; collection invokes `game.onPickup(p.type)`. No reward-crate pickup exists yet.
- Potential per-frame costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are hypotheses, not benchmark results.

## Objective
- Improve SACI STRIKE’s smoothness and implement weapon selection plus a Saci reward-crate mechanic.

## Requirements
- Defeating Saci gives the player a crate; spinning it hides the contents before awarding a weapon.
- Awarded weapons have infinite ammunition and remain usable after pickup.
- Spinning the crate makes Saci focus on the player and become twice as fast and twice as strong/healthy.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected enemy, weapon, pickup, input, UI, and game-loop code.

### Active
- Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
- Identify and improve sources of choppiness, then verify the game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the reward crate, spin/reward flow, weapon selection, and Saci behavior.
2. Investigate performance, make improvements, and verify the game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Enemy-kill and pickup callbacks, game state, update/render loop.
- `src/enemies.js`: Saci behavior, health, movement, and defeat handling.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon inventory, firing, ammunition, and switching.
- `src/input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- `src/pickups.js`: Pickup spawning, animation, and collection.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, screens, and toasts.
- `index.html`: Game UI markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Game UI and touch-control styling.
- `src/world.js`: World construction and per-frame animated updates.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `WeaponSystem` currently has `berimbau` and `foguete`; rocket ammunition is finite by default.
- Keyboard `1`/`2` currently both enqueue a weapon switch rather than selecting a specific slot.
- Saci currently has 20 HP and moves at 4.4 units/s while rushing toward the player.
- `PickupManager.spawn(type, pos)` creates pickups; collection invokes `game.onPickup(p.type)`. No reward-crate pickup exists yet.
- `onEnemyKilled` currently gives Saci an 18% chance to drop a standard pickup.
- Potential per-frame costs include two render passes and frequent system/HUD updates; these are hypotheses, not benchmark results.
